states.name: Remote Control QR & Host Pairing
states.description: Scans Antigravity Desktop v2.30.0 Remote Control QR code (https://antigravity.google.com/r/<id>) or connects via direct Tailscale/LAN host.

states.name: Workspace & Jetbox Conversation Catalog
states.description: Displays connected host lt74xt6l0m-golden-star, active Git worktrees, and real-time JetboxSubscribeToSummaries conversations with <10ms SQLite cold start.

states.name: Cascade Active Streaming & Multi-Step Trajectory
states.description: 120fps streaming conversation with TaskBoundary progress header, collapsible Thinking capsule, CodeAction pills, RunCommand terminal card, and Liquid Glass Composer.

states.name: Native Permission Approval & TurnGrants Sheet
states.description: Handles CORTEX_STEP_STATUS_WAITING (9) with requestedInteraction (runCommand / permission / filePermission) offering Allow Once, Always Allow in Turn (turnGrants), and Safe Auto-Accept.

states.name: Interactive AskQuestion Elicitation Card
states.description: Renders native multi-choice / single-choice selection sheet when the Agent invokes ask_question, with recommended badge and custom write-in input.

states.name: Artifact Implementation Plan & Generative UI Preview
states.description: Displays Antigravity implementation_plan.md artifact with GitHub alerts, Mermaid architecture diagram, and native 'Proceed with Plan' feedback bar.

states.name: Native Word-Level Turn Diff & Patch Inspector
states.description: Renders GetTurnDiff / GetPatchAndCodeChange word-level additions/deletions with file tree tabs and hunk navigation.

states.name: Dynamic Island & Lock Screen Live Activity
states.description: Displays iOS 18 Dynamic Island (Expanded & Compact) and Lock Screen Live Activity banner with real-time step progress, elapsed timer, and interactive AppIntent Approve button.

events.trigger: Receive 5-byte Connect envelope with initial snapshot + incremental summary delta
Select active conversation row; fetch binary protobuf steps and subscribe to StreamCascadeReactiveUpdates
Receive step with status=CORTEX_STEP_STATUS_WAITING (9) and requestedInteraction.permission / runCommand
Tap 'Always Allow in Turn' or 'Approve Command' -> dispatches matching oneof member to LanguageServerService
Receive step with requestedInteraction.askQuestion -> user selects option and submits
Tap Artifact card (implementation_plan.md) or 'Review Plan' button
Tap grouped file changes summary block (+184 -22 across 4 files)
App enters background during active Cascade or WAITING permission gate; ActivityKit updates Dynamic Island & Lock Screen

claims.behavior: QR Scanner & Host Pairing screen displays camera viewfinder for Antigravity Desktop QR code, parsed device badge 'lt74xt6l0m-golden-star (v2.30.0)', and Dual-Channel connection selector (Cloud Relay vs Direct LAN/Tailscale) with >=44pt buttons.

Home screen shows connected host pill 'lt74xt6l0m-golden-star', Git worktree filter bar, Pinned & Recent cascades synced via JetboxSubscribeToSummaries, live status badges (RUNNING / WAITING / DONE), and quick New Cascade action.

Cascade chat screen renders TaskBoundary progress bar, collapsible Thinking block, grouped file modification evidence block, native RunCommand terminal card with exit code 0, and Liquid Glass Composer with model/effort pill (Claude Sonnet 4.5 · High).

Waiting step triggers native glass Permission Gate sheet displaying command/resource details, risk badge, Safe Auto-Accept toggle, and three distinct >=44pt action buttons (Allow Once, Always Allow in Turn, Reject).
Agent ask_question tool call renders native interactive choice sheet with '(Recommended)' badge, selectable option cards (>=44pt), custom write-in field, and Submit Answer button.

Artifact viewer renders implementation_plan.md with IMPORTANT alert callout, architecture flow diagram, clickable file symbol badges, and bottom RequestFeedback approval bar ('Proceed with Plan' & 'Request Changes').
Turn Diff inspector displays file switcher tabs, addition/deletion counters (+184 -22), line-numbered unified diff with word-level green/red highlights, and Accept/Revert Hunk controls.

claims.category: Dynamic Island & Lock Screen Live Activity
claims.behavior: iOS 18 Lock Screen & Dynamic Island showcase compact island, expanded island with step progress & timer, and Lock Screen Live Activity notification with one-tap interactive 'Approve Command' AppIntent button.
